evidence_items.locator: Section 4, Blocksworld evaluation; human baseline follows in the same section
evidence_items.explanation: The study tested GPT-4 between March and May and found substantial failures in generating executable plans. Its instructed human baseline produced valid plans for 39 of 50 participants, supporting a concrete competence gap without assuming human perfection.

unresolved_gaps: The evaluation tests a bounded planning domain, not every dimension of intelligence.
The human baseline consists of instructed participants, not a representative sample of trained professionals.
